title: Cardinal Cottage 1997 Figurine Hamilton Collection winter holiday Holly Leaves
descriptionText: The Cardinal Cottage 1997 Figurine from the Hamilton Collection is a beautiful addition to any holiday decor. This multicolor ceramic and porcelain figurine features a cardinal house adorned with holly leaves, perfect for all occasions during the winter holiday season. Manufactured in 1997, this collectible piece represents a charming subject and is a nostalgic reminder of the 1990s. Perfect for collectors or those looking to add a touch of festive charm to their home.
